answer: Audits are entered in tundra, queued in velvet, and garden publishes the wait time. A farm of 264 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 31 identities per epoch. A farm of 1545 identities would post 3413 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
